title: Runs score mechanically: report table → cell table → plot

brief.why: The instrument's value is re-runnability (surfaces change monthly; the map is a film). Three parseable runs from 2026-08-15 sit in ~/notes/practices/harness-cartography/runs/ waiting for exactly this — instrument.md §7 said 'build it when the runner repo mints', and the repo minted 2026-08-23.
brief.what: 1. Parser: run .md → structured report (src/harness_cartography/scoring) 2. Scorer: report → cell table per §6 mapping 3. Plotter: cell tables → Freedom/Furniture projection 4. Tests against the three 2026-08-15 parseable runs as fixtures
brief.done: All three 2026-08-15 parseable runs (cowork-local, cowork-cloud, cowork-chrome) score end-to-end without hand-editing, and one plot renders all scored surfaces with both threshold lines.
brief.how: Parse the letter's report table (12 items, one row each, plus three free-text lines) from a run .md → map items to rubric cells via instrument.md §6 → emit a cell table where every cell carries level + friction + wall type + provenance + date (refuse undated cells) → project onto Freedom/Furniture axes with shell-line and browser-line markers. Report format is defined by the letter (notes-side); if parsing needs format changes, that is a letter edit decided in notes.

done_note: Done criteria met and verified by cold-eyes subagent (2026-08-23): all five runs (not just the required three) score end-to-end unedited — verifier reproduced the artifacts byte-identical from the committed code; plot carries both threshold encodings. The verify caught an act-rated defect before anyone saw the projection: keyword upgrades fired on vocabulary the letter's own questions plant (cowork-chrome scored self_extension 3 against its own 'no direct route' evidence; shipped gemini Freedom disagreed with its adjudicated cells 12 vs 11). Fixed same night: upgrades key only on unplanted markers, planted-vocab boundaries are hint-flags at the rule floor, wall types + provenance now render per the instrument's cell notation, regression tests added (13 green). Regenerated projection agrees with adjudicated cells (gemini 11). Residue filed as cart-zedawu: friction (✓-tax) modeling, label overprint, hint-visibility on the plot.

title: Build scoring pipeline v1: parser, rule scorer, Freedom/Furniture plot, fixture tests

brief.why: First action under cart-cefawo. Five runs now exist (four 2026-08-15 + gemini-notebook 2026-08-23) in four table dialects; the §6 item→boundary mapping makes a rule-based scorer mechanical for most cells.
brief.what: 1. parsing.py: run .md → structured report 2. scoring.py: report → cell table via §6 rules 3. plotting.py: cell tables → projection PNG 4. cli.py + tests green 5. End-to-end over all five real runs
brief.done: pytest green; score CLI runs over the three 2026-08-15 parseable runs plus gemini-notebook without hand-editing; one PNG renders all scored surfaces with both threshold lines.
brief.how: Parser tolerant of all dialects (bare numbers vs labelled items, ✓ vs Yes, 4 vs 5 columns, mixed outcomes). Scorer assigns only levels the passed items prove (item N ✓ ⇒ dimension ≥ boundary level), flags mixed/judgement cells rather than guessing — refuse undated cells per instrument rule. Plot: Freedom (7 primitive dims) vs Furniture (output rendering), one point per surface, shell + browser threshold markers. Tests: hermetic vendored fixture + skipif-present tests over the real notes run files.

title: Administer the letter to Gemini Notebook via passe — first browser-administered run

brief.why: From the Toolmaking queue line (2026-08-23): 'Gemini Notebook probe + letter v2'. Gemini Notebook is the corner specimen (near-zero freedom, maximal furniture) and it is growing a per-notebook cloud code-execution machine — the padded room getting a workbench — so re-measure rather than assume (instrument.md §3). Also the first run administered by passe rather than by hand, so it proves the browser administration route itself.
brief.what: 1. Letter v2 landed notes-side (prerequisite) 2. Passe runner script or documented manual-passe sequence 3. Run report at ~/notes/practices/harness-cartography/runs/gemini-notebook-<date>.md in the house format 4. Room Status updated
brief.done: runs/gemini-notebook-<date>.md exists with the full report table, provenance measured, and the administration route (passe) recorded in its header.
brief.how: Load the passe skill FIRST (cookbook is mandatory before any passe command). Letter v2 must land in instrument.md before this run — administer v2, not v1. Use tube's logged-in Chrome (passe-chrome on :9223; check the unit is up — it is session-scoped to xrdp). Create a fresh notebook, paste the letter, collect the report. Defaults first per the ceiling-not-default rule; note which Google account carries the surface (run-time fact, instrument.md §7). Canary is per-surface (CANARY-gemini-notebook-2026-08 or subject's own naming — its choice of name is part of the report).
